🚨Fear for HMPV is rising faster than its cases but don't fall for misinformation about HMPV!
✅ It's a respiratory virus, not a new pandemic.
✅ It spreads like the flu—via droplets & surfaces.
✅ Early medical intervention can help recovery.
#HMPV #FactsNotFear #HMPVinIndia
